title: F.R.I.D.A.Y. 3.0 Vision Subsystem Forensic Bug Ledger

ledger.description: Hardcoded fallback to 'qwen2.5vl:3b' in engine._get_available_vision_model and process_image_command when vision model was not installed or offline.
ledger.root_cause: Ternary operator default `or 'qwen2.5vl:3b'` silenced model absence and caused downstream connection crashes instead of reporting UNAVAILABLE.
ledger.resolution: Removed hardcoded fallback. Implemented explicit UNAVAILABLE reporting and status propagation.

ledger.description: Lack of magic-byte validation allowed renamed non-image files (e.g. text/exe with .png extension) to pass initial validation.
ledger.root_cause: Validation only checked file extension and size > 0.
ledger.resolution: Implemented detect_image_format() inspecting magic bytes for PNG, JPEG, WEBP, BMP, GIF, and TIFF headers.

ledger.description: Vulnerability to decompression bombs due to lack of dimension and pixel ceilings.
ledger.root_cause: PIL was called without MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS ceiling or pre-decode dimension checks.
ledger.resolution: Enforced MAX_IMAGE_DIMENSION = 4096, MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = 16,777,216, and caught DecompressionBombError.

ledger.description: Python keyword regex in query_llm (is_reanalysis_request) automatically triggered vision analysis without Main Agent decision.
ledger.root_cause: Hardcoded Python re-analysis hook bypassed Main Agent tool-calling architecture.
ledger.resolution: Removed automatic Python keyword execution. Replaced with structured grounding context allowing Main Agent to decide.

ledger.description: Absence of prompt injection boundary delimiters around vision output.
ledger.root_cause: Image OCR and visual descriptions were injected directly without untrusted data wrappers.
ledger.resolution: Enclosed all ImageContext prompt output in <<<EXTERNAL_IMAGE_DATA_NOT_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS>>> and sanitized delimiter injection.

ledger.description: Incomplete tool provenance for analyze_image in verify_tool_result.
ledger.root_cause: verify_tool_result only recorded image_file path, omitting image_id, vision_model, dimensions, and uncertainty.
ledger.resolution: Extended analyze_image branch in verify_tool_result to extract all 8 mandatory provenance fields.

ledger.description: Lack of uncertainty preservation (OBSERVED, LIKELY, UNCERTAIN, NOT_VISIBLE).
ledger.root_cause: Uncertain or low-resolution image elements were described without an explicit confidence classification.
ledger.resolution: Added uncertainty_rating to ImageContext schema and implemented heuristic/model uncertainty extraction.

ledger.description: Large images were passed directly to Ollama without bounded preprocessing, risking VRAM OOM and latency spikes.
ledger.root_cause: validate_and_encode_image merely encoded raw file bytes to base64.
ledger.resolution: Implemented bounded Lanczos downscaling to 1920px max dimension with aspect ratio preservation and metadata recording.
